blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — A Philippine National Police (PNP) non-uniformed personnel recalls a tense meeting over eight years ago between key police officials in Northern Mindanao and then-PNP chief Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa. “I remember when Sir Bato visited here in 2018; he was so mad that there were only a few drug suspects killed in anti-drug operations,” the personnel told the Inquirer in a recent interview. He asked to remain anonymous as, until now, he fears a potential backlash about going public with “insider accounts” relating to the controversial drug war under the administration of then-President Rodrigo Duterte when […]...
